newsitem.title: USA: H.B. Fuller raises prices of adhesives products.
newsitem.headline: H.B. Fuller raises prices of adhesives products.

text.p: H.B. Fuller Co said it will raise prices on April 30 by four to six percent on its hot melt, water-based and certain specialty adhesive product lines.
Prices were increased to offset higher costs of raw materials used to make these products and to some supply/demand imbalances of certain petrochemical feedstocks, the company said in a statement.
H.B. Fuller makes and markets adhesives, sealants, coatings, paints and other specialty chemicals.
